description: For language maps \(j:L\to K\), \(k:K\to H\), and term \(t\), \((k\circ j)_*t=k_*(j_*t)\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.LHom.comp_onTerm.{u, v, u', u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {L' : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type u'} {L'' : FirstOrder.Language} (φ : L' →ᴸ L'') (ψ : L →ᴸ L') : (φ.comp ψ).onTerm = φ.onTerm ∘ ψ.onTerm
